summary: Focused regression + new host feature testing. Backend: added TestHost class (6 new tests) to /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covering default host on ps-01, 15 properties backfilled, PUT host (auth + unauth), host photo upload/delete + /api/files/ serving, and auth guards. Total 21/21 pytest tests pass. Frontend: /casa/ps-01 renders Conheça o anfitrião card (data-testid=host-card) between Sobre a casa and O que esta casa oferece, showing Família Fonseca, Anfitrião desde 2019, bio, Responde em até 1 hora, Português/Inglês. Admin /admin/casas/ps-01 shows Anfitrião section (admin-host-section) with admin-host-name/bio/upload inputs. Edited name to 'TEST_Carlos & Marina', uploaded tiny PNG via admin-host-upload (LABEL wrapping file input), saved — public page then rendered the updated name and the host-photo element. Restored defaults via API after test.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 486 lines — still within manageable but add_host_photo/delete_host_photo are near-duplicates of upload_photo/delete_photo logic for property photos; consider extracting a shared helper to upload-to-objstore + persist a path field (DRY).

HostInfo defaults use mutable list ['Português','Inglês'] via field default on BaseModel — pydantic v2 handles this correctly, but migration backfill (default_host = HostInfo().model_dump()) runs on every startup, which is idempotent via $exists filter — good.

POST /api/properties/{id}/host-photo does not delete the previous host.photo_storage_path when a new one is uploaded. Over time this orphans files in object storage. Delete old path before setting new.

Frontend host card renders 'Responde em até 1 hora' using host.response_time concatenated with 'Responde em até' prefix; backend already stores 'em até 1 hora' which yields 'Responde em até em até 1 hora' risk if admin changes response_time to include the prefix. Document the expected format or guard it.

AdminPropertyEdit.jsx — label wraps file input with data-testid on the LABEL rather than the input itself. Works for Playwright by walking down to inner input, but inconsistent with other data-testid conventions on real inputs.
seed_data_creation: No new seed; test modifies ps-01 host and uploads a photo to ps-02, then restores defaults and deletes the host photo via API in teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Host feature wiring: GET /api/properties/{id} returns host object with name/bio/photo/photo_storage_path/since/languages/response_time. PUT accepts host in payload (PropertyIn.host). POST /api/properties/{id}/host-photo and DELETE /api/properties/{id}/host-photo manage the photo. Public host card data-testids: host-card, host-name, host-photo. Admin edit data-testids: admin-host-section, admin-host-name, admin-host-bio, admin-host-upload (LABEL wrapping <input type=file>). All 15 seeded properties are backfilled with default host on startup via migration.
